svg.text: The states both parties keep, and the message that moves each one. One party's record in Portitor: NegotiationState and next_state in crates/portitor-dsp/src/negotiation.rs
Either party may terminate in every state in this box (DSP text: "MAY be sent at any state"; ADR 0006).
C: sent by the consumer. P: sent by the provider. event X: ContractNegotiationEventMessage with eventType X. Thick border: final state.
A state changes only when the other party acknowledges the message (DSP 2025-1). Until then Portitor keeps the message as pending, with the state (outbox, ADR 0007).
Every other message is refused with HTTP 400 and a ContractNegotiationError.
Source: DSP 2025-1 (tag 2025-1-err2), Contract Negotiation Protocol, State Machine figure; see docs/spikes/1.x-negotiation-state-machine.md.
